issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to create a constructor that follows the attribute order from the UML diagram, where the UML lists numberOfInscribedStudents before lectureName. The provided solution's constructor uses a different parameter order (lectureName first, then numberOfInscribedStudents, ...). This mismatch between the UML ordering in the problem statement and the solution's constructor parameter order can confuse students about the expected constructor signature and cause tests that check constructor parameters/order to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order consistent with the UML order described in the problem statement. Either (A) update the solution (and any reference implementation/tests) so the constructor follows the UML ordering (e.g. int numberOfInscribedStudents, String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfTutors), or (B) update the UML and problem text to specify the constructor parameter order used in the solution (lectureName first). Also update the template comments to explicitly state the chosen parameter order so students implement the expected signature.
